_comment: Blocks every matching file MUST contain, enforced by scripts/bake-shared.mjs.
This is the 'presence' half of the guarantee: baking keeps a block that IS there
in sync, but only this policy stops a skill from shipping without it at all.
Patterns support * (one path segment) and ** (any number of segments). A file
matching several patterns must satisfy the union of their requirements.
Keys beginning with _ are documentation, not patterns.
Patterns are 'skills/<name>/*.md', not '.../SKILL.md', so that renaming an entry
file cannot drop its requirements silently.
preamble + env-vars go in EVERY skill: an agent may load exactly one, so without
the anti-prior warning it falls back on Cloudinary/ImageKit habits, and without
the variable table it invents variable names.
api-key goes in every skill that could lead an agent to write code touching a key
or an upload: autorender, upload, react, nextjs, video and mcp. It is omitted
only from transformations and view, which build public delivery URLs and never
need an API key.
delivery-surface goes in skills that discuss public delivery URLs — transformations,
view and video. Skills that neither teach nor accept raw delivery tokens omit it, and
it never authorizes undocumented delivery tokens or features.
crop-modes and width-ladder are shared only where a skill teaches those URL
invariants. A skill may omit them when it delegates to the public reference.
unknown-tokens is required where a skill teaches raw URL token grammar. Other
skills delegate to the public transformation reference.
Adding a skill without these blocks fails CI by design — amend deliberately.
